_doc: Hand-maintained: printed parts a builder cannot regenerate as a native STEP from a script in the tree, and what fixing each takes (owner 2026-11-17: a part that cannot be recreated from a script is a defect; 2026-11-20: list what refactoring takes). robot/body/bom/build.py matches `parts` (globs) against the selected manifest and shows each group on BOM.md with the parts it still matches; remove a group when its parts are fixed. Effort: small = one parametric script, under a session; medium = a builder change plus a check run; large = a new modelling method. Evidence: robot/body/bom/inventory.py (2026-11-20) and a search of every commit including tag archive/private-main-20261120.

groups.state: STEP and STL exist only in artifacts/cove50-sensor-integration/original-shell-layout-20261026 (pinned input, no producer recorded). No commit, private history included, holds the script that wrote them; only robot/electronics-integration/r1-20261026/render.py (commit ebc1c3118) reads them.
groups.fix: Rewrite as one parametric script (robot/body/neck-head/head_electronics.py) from the measured STEPs: standoffs and guard are extrusions (small); fan lead guide small; head skin and neck collar are organic shells: rebuild as a loft / offset of the head profile against the ape look reference (medium).

groups.state: STEP in artifacts/cove50-power-integration/internal-r33-20261025/installed-torso-r8|r9 (not a pinned input). Code at commit b46960e7b / ebc1c3118 (robot/power-integration/cad/internal-r33-20261025, private history), not in the tree.
groups.fix: Spacers: one parametric extrusion each (small). Chest indicator relief: port the relief cut from the r33 builder into the torso shell script, or drop it if the r33 indicator is no longer fitted (small).

groups.state: Native STEP missing everywhere (artifacts/cove50-sensor-integration/v4/parts, not in the blob index); only the mesh morphed by robot/body/ape-proportions/build.py exists.
groups.fix: Parametric backing plate per FSR site from the FSR 402 footprint and the foot sole, in the foot builder (small).

groups.state: Built by scripts in the tree (assemble_complete_fdm_body.py forearm barrel covers; ape-proportions/build.py lower cover) but written only as .npz meshes, then morphed as meshes.
groups.fix: Export the B-rep the builder already constructs as STEP and apply the ape-proportions stretch to it (OCC general transform for the axial stretch) instead of to the mesh (medium).

groups.state: An upstream STEP exists (artifacts/robot/body/assembly/parts), but robot/body/ape-proportions/build.py stretches the mesh and records the STEP as native_step_unmorphed, so the selected body has no STEP. The cradle is a structural carrier: its checks run on the mesh.
groups.fix: Same as above: stretch the B-rep in build.py (BRepBuilderAPI_GTransform for the axial scale; a piecewise stretch needs a split, scale, fuse) and write native_step (medium). Do the cradle first: it carries load.

groups.state: Regenerable by script (ape-proportions/shells.py voxel sweep + marching cubes; leg/thigh_shell.py; ape-proportions/build.py) but mesh only by method. The STL prints; the B-rep checks screen them as closed meshes.
groups.fix: Not a recreation defect. A native STEP needs a B-rep shell method (offset surface or loft of sections) instead of voxels (large); only worth it if a check or a supplier needs B-rep.
